instructions_to_main_agent: Delete the menu video element and menu video imports from speisekarte.tsx as explicitly requested.
Ensure all ~90 menu items display exact item names, descriptions, and prices directly in structured card/list format.
Apply clear Italian flag accents (Verde #008C45, Bianco #FFFFFF, Rosso #CD212A) on buttons, ribbons, headings, and active state indicators over a warm off-white background (#FDFBF7).
Wrap page root elements with Lenis smooth scroll and framer-motion section animations.
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, links, search inputs, menu category filters, and modal targets for automated test stability.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for header or modals without backdrop blur and solid tint fallback.
Maintain high text contrast (APCA AA compliant) against light backgrounds.
Ensure all interactive elements have explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case.
